514: - **[PB-TEXT-HOLDS-DOF] Sketch text counts toward `isFullyConstrained`, so a labelled sketch never
515:   reports fully constrained.** Text placed with `setAsAlongPath` (`[PB-SKETCH-TEXT]`) carries its
516:   own position along the curve, and nothing in the recipes here pins it. A sketch whose geometry is
517:   completely determined therefore still reads `False` purely because it is labelled. Measured in
518:   Fusion 2026-09-02 on the spur tooth sketch: `False` with its four circle labels, `True` for the
519:   same sketch with the labels deleted and no other change.
520:   - **What to do.** A gear that labels a sketch cannot gate that sketch on `isFullyConstrained`;
521:     log the result rather than raising. **This exempts the labels and nothing else** — never read it
522:     as licence for loose geometry, and gate every sketch that carries no text normally.

.claude/skills/generate-gear/PLAYBOOK.md
660: - **[PB-PATTERN-BODIES] Patterns return original + copies:** `CircularPatternFeature.bodies` already includes the
661:   seed body plus copies, so don't re-add the seed. **Copy them into an `ObjectCollection` first** —
662:   `pattern.bodies` is a `BRepBodies`, and `combineFeatures.createInput(targetBody: BRepBody,
663:   toolBodies: core.ObjectCollection)` rejects it. Loop `pattern.bodies.item(i)` into a fresh
664:   `adsk.core.ObjectCollection.create()` and pass that.

410: adsk.fusion.CombineFeatures.createInput  [method]
411: signature: (self, targetBody: BRepBody, toolBodies: core.ObjectCollection) -> CombineFeatureInput
412: Creates a CombineFeatureInput object. Use properties and methods on this object
413: to define the combine you want to create and then use the Add method, passing in
414: the CombineFeatureInput object.
415: targetBody : A BRep body that represents the blank body.
416: toolBodies : An ObjectCollection containing one or more BRep bodies that represent tool bodies.
417: Returns the newly created CombineFeatureInput object or null if the creation failed.
